# Free calculators and checks for people who run a small business

> 271 free, browser-only tools served directly from marisstella.dev, for marketplace sellers, trade contractors, logistics buyers, and small teams preparing compliance evidence. No account, no payment, no upload: every calculation runs in the visitor's own browser and the numbers they type never leave their device.

Each tool is a static page that works offline once opened, and is free with no
gated features. They are estimates and records to act on, not professional
advice or a determination made on anyone's behalf; each page carries its own
limitations.

Every tool in the collection is listed below — all 271 of them — and
every one is linked at a URL this host serves. Nothing is held back for
another hostname: tools.marisstella.dev is reserved as this collection's
eventual canonical address, is not serving yet, and is named here only so it
is not mistaken for a fuller index — a link there would resolve to nothing
today.

Every tool above can be embedded in another site's page, free, including on
commercial sites: load its URL with ?pfEmbed=1 inside an <iframe>
(1400px is a reasonable starting height). The embedded view keeps the same
arithmetic and the same disclaimer as the full page and links back to it, runs
entirely in the visitor's browser, and adds no tracking of any kind to the
page that hosts it.

## Trade & contractor bids

- [Change Order Margin Calculator — Price the Added Work](https://marisstella.dev/tools/change-order-margin-calculator/): Price a construction change order from loaded labor, materials, subs, schedule delay and overhead — and see what your contract's markup cap actually leaves you.
- [Subcontractor Cash Flow Planner — Payment Delay Gap](https://marisstella.dev/tools/subcontractor-cashflow-planner/): Free subcontractor cash flow planner: see the funding gap from payment terms, retention and late payment — what bridging it costs, and which lever closes it.
- [Free Contractor Bid Readiness Checklist](https://marisstella.dev/tools/contractor-bid-readiness/): Check a contractor RFP or bid submission for missing documents, owners, and deadline risks. Free, private, and browser-local.
- [Construction Daily Log and Change Order Evidence Pack](https://marisstella.dev/tools/construction-evidence-log/): Free private construction daily log and change order documentation tool for small contractors. Create a dated, reviewable evidence pack in your browser, saved locally so you can export a combined pack across the whole project.
- [Tender Bid Readiness Checker for Small Contractors](https://marisstella.dev/tools/tender-bid-readiness/): Paste a public tender and get a fast bid-readiness checklist for deadlines, bonds, insurance, certifications, questions, and submission instructions. Runs privately in your browser.
- [Job Cost Variance Calculator](https://marisstella.dev/tools/job-margin-variance/): Compare estimated and actual job hours and costs to find the largest job cost variance before your next contractor quote.
- [Appliance Repair Quote Calculator — Repair vs Replace](https://marisstella.dev/tools/appliance-repair-quote-calculator/): Price an appliance repair service call, then see whether finishing the repair still beats recommending replace — customer cost per remaining year versus what you keep if they decline.
- [HVAC Maintenance Contract Pricing Calculator](https://marisstella.dev/tools/hvac-maintenance-contract-calculator/): Free HVAC maintenance contract pricing calculator. Price preventive visits, callbacks, parts reserve, overhead, and target margin without underbidding the agreement.
- [Cleaning Chemical Dilution Cost Calculator](https://marisstella.dev/tools/cleaning-dilution-calculator/): Calculate commercial cleaning chemical cost per ready-to-use gallon, bucket, and job from concentrate dilution and supplier price.

## CI checks & developer gates

- [GitHub Actions Artifact Poisoning Check — workflow_run Download & Execute](https://marisstella.dev/tools/actions-artifact-poisoning-check/): Paste your GitHub Actions workflow YAML and find a workflow_run job that downloads an artifact and later executes something from it, plus a download-artifact step with no name: pin. Free, runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.
- [GitHub Actions Cache Poisoning Check — Fork-Writable Cache & restore-keys](https://marisstella.dev/tools/actions-cache-poisoning-check/): Paste your GitHub Actions workflow YAML and find actions/cache steps reachable from pull_request_target/workflow_run, and restore-keys fallbacks that can adopt a poisoned prefix match. Free, runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.
- [GitHub Actions Injection Check — Pwn Requests & Script Injection](https://marisstella.dev/tools/actions-injection-check/): Paste your GitHub Actions workflow YAML and find pull_request_target/workflow_run 'pwn request' checkouts and shell script-injection from untrusted ${{ github.event }} expressions. Free, runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.
- [GitHub Actions Minutes Estimator — What Will This Workflow Cost?](https://marisstella.dev/tools/actions-minutes-estimator/): Paste your GitHub Actions workflow YAML and see projected monthly billable minutes and dollar cost before the allowance runs out. Names the expensive patterns: the macOS 10x multiplier, per-job rounding on wide matrices, missing timeout-minutes, PR commits built twice, over-frequent cron. Free, runs entirely in your browser, nothing is uploaded.
- [Actions Permissions Check — Does Your GITHUB_TOKEN Use Least Privilege?](https://marisstella.dev/tools/actions-permissions-check/): Paste your GitHub Actions workflow YAML and find every workflow or job with no explicit permissions block (running on the ambient default) or permissions: write-all. Free, runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.
- [Actions Runner Starvation Check — Is Your Red CI Even Real?](https://marisstella.dev/tools/actions-runner-starvation-check/): Paste the JSON from a GitHub Actions run and find out in one click whether a red check is a real failure or GitHub silently never assigned it a runner. Free, runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.
- [Actions Self-Hosted Exposure Check — Is Your Self-Hosted Runner Exposed to Forks?](https://marisstella.dev/tools/actions-self-hosted-exposure-check/): Paste your GitHub Actions workflow YAML and find every job that runs on a self-hosted label in a workflow triggered by pull_request, pull_request_target, workflow_run, or issue_comment — the exact pattern GitHub's own docs warn against on public repos. Free, runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.
- [AI Coding Plan Cost Calculator — Subscription vs. API](https://marisstella.dev/tools/ai-coding-plan-cost-calculator/): Is your Claude Max, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or ChatGPT Plus plan actually cheaper than paying per token through the API? Enter your own usage and rates and see the monthly cost both ways, plus the break-even point. Free, runs entirely in your browser, nothing is uploaded.
- [AI Crawler Access Check — Which AI Bots Does Your robots.txt Block?](https://marisstella.dev/tools/ai-crawler-access-check/): Paste your robots.txt and find out in one click whether GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended, PerplexityBot, and 11 other named AI crawlers are allowed, blocked, or partially blocked — plus a structural check of your llms.txt. Free, runs entirely in your browser, nothing is uploaded.
- [App Store Screenshot Checker — Catch a Rejected Icon or Wrong-Size Screenshot Before Upload](https://marisstella.dev/tools/app-store-screenshot-check/): Free tool: drop your App Store Connect or Google Play listing images in and check them before you upload — app icon transparency (the classic "can't contain an alpha channel" rejection), wrong pixel dimensions, a HEIC renamed to .png, and a screenshot set whose members disagree about their own size. Runs entirely in your browser; nothing is uploaded. A zero-dependency CLI does the same in CI.
- [Cache-Control Checker — Vary: *, public + Set-Cookie, weak ETags](https://marisstella.dev/tools/cache-control-check/): Free tool: run a CLI that sends one real request to your site, then paste the JSON here for a plain-English report on Vary: * (uncacheable forever), Cache-Control: public alongside a Set-Cookie header (a shared cache can leak one visitor's cookie to another), and lower-severity caching directive conflicts. Nothing uploaded.
- [Canonical Tag Checker — Conflicting, Cross-Domain & Dead-End Canonicals](https://marisstella.dev/tools/canonical-tag-check/): Free tool: fetch a URL for real and get a plain-English report on canonical-tag misconfigurations -- conflicting tags, a canonical pointing at a different domain, or a canonical that 404s or is itself marked noindex. Nothing uploaded.
- [Caption Quality Checker — SRT & WebVTT Reading Speed, Line Length & Timing](https://marisstella.dev/tools/caption-quality-check/): Free tool: paste an SRT or WebVTT caption file and check it against commonly-used caption style-guide thresholds -- reading speed (characters per second), line length, lines per cue, minimum/maximum duration, overlapping cues, and too-short gaps between cues. A zero-dependency CLI runs the same checks in your own CI. Nothing uploaded.
- [Chrome Extension Permission Checker — Unused & Missing Permissions](https://marisstella.dev/tools/chrome-extension-permission-check/): Free, browser-local checker: scans your extension's JavaScript/TypeScript source for chrome.* API usage and compares it against manifest.json's declared permissions, so an unused or missing permission doesn't cost you a Chrome Web Store rejection ('Purple Potassium'). Nothing is uploaded.

- [Poshmark Fee Calculator — What You Actually Keep After Fees](https://marisstella.dev/tools/poshmark-fee-calculator/): Free Poshmark seller fee calculator. The flat $2.95 fee under $15, 20% at $15+, the $14.75 break-even price, your real profit after item cost, and whether a lower offer costs you more than the discount. Nothing leaves your browser.
- [Shopify Fee Calculator — Payments vs PayPal vs Grow](https://marisstella.dev/tools/shopify-fee-calculator/): Free Shopify fee calculator: see order profit after Shopify Payments or PayPal/Stripe, including the extra Shopify third-party transaction fee. Then compare Basic, Grow, Advanced, and Plus at your monthly volume.
- [Whatnot Seller Payout Calculator — Keep After 8% + Processing](https://marisstella.dev/tools/whatnot-seller-payout/): Free Whatnot seller fee calculator. Commission on the hammer, processing on the checkout total (item + shipping + tax) plus $0.30, the $1,500 TCG cap, leftover after the label, and whether free shipping is cheaper. Nothing leaves your browser.
- [Where to Sell Calculator — eBay vs Etsy vs Amazon](https://marisstella.dev/tools/where-to-sell-calculator/): Free marketplace fee comparison calculator: enter one item once and see net profit after fees, after returns, per day of wait, and per month of shelf time on eBay, Etsy, Amazon, Reverb, your own store, and a local sale.

- [Affiliate Disclosure Checker — Is Your Amazon/FTC Disclosure Missing or Too Late?](https://marisstella.dev/tools/affiliate-disclosure-checker/): Paste a blog post's HTML and see every affiliate link it recognises (Amazon Associates tag= links, amzn.to, rel=sponsored, ShareASale/CJ/Impact/Skimlinks/AWIN tracking links) and whether a disclosure appears before the first one — plus whether an Amazon link carries Amazon's own required exact statement. Free, runs entirely in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

Paste the text copied out of your resume and instantly see the formatting issues that break applicant-tracking-system parsing — icon-font bullets, missing headings, buried contact info, and more.

No sign-up, nothing uploaded.

- [Craft Fair Booth Calculator — Is This Market Worth Taking?](https://marisstella.dev/tools/craft-fair-booth-calculator/): Free calculator for makers: find what one craft fair, farmers market, or art festival booth has to sell to break even after booth fee, jury fee, mileage, materials, and card fees — plus your real hourly rate for the weekend and the most a booth could cost and still be worth it. Unsold stock is treated as inventory, not a loss.

Free, no signup, runs entirely in your browser. Download a shareable HTML one-sheet or copy a plain-text version for email.

- [Media Kit Generator — Free Sponsorship One-Sheet for Content Creators](https://marisstella.dev/tools/influencer-media-kit-generator/): Build a professional sponsorship media kit for your channel in minutes — bio, platform reach, audience breakdown, past brand partnerships, and your rate card. Free, no signup, runs entirely in your browser. Download a shareable HTML one-sheet or copy a plain-text version for email.

## Logistics, freight & cloud cost

- [Medical Courier Route Calculator — Per-Stop Pricing](https://marisstella.dev/tools/medical-courier-route-margin/): Free medical courier route calculator: margin per stop and vehicle-hour after paid wait, deadhead and overhead — plus the per-stop rate to quote.
- [Owner Operator CPM Calculator — Deadhead-Adjusted Rate](https://marisstella.dev/tools/owner-operator-cpm-calculator/): Free owner-operator CPM calculator: fuel, truck note, insurance, and deadhead miles in one week. See all-in cost per mile and the loaded rate that actually covers the empty ones.
- [3PL Cost Calculator](https://marisstella.dev/tools/3pl-quote-normalizer/): Compare a third-party logistics quote with in-house fulfillment costs, minimum monthly spend, and true cost per order.
- [Freight Accessorial Invoice Auditor](https://marisstella.dev/tools/freight-accessorial-auditor/): Audit freight accessorial invoices for duplicate, over-expected, and missing-code charges before you pay. Free, private, and runs in your browser.
- [LTL Freight Class Estimator](https://marisstella.dev/tools/ltl-freight-class-estimator/): Estimate LTL freight class from pallet dimensions, weight, and piece count — then see the packed height that reaches the next class down, and the height at which a carrier remeasure re-rates the shipment.
- [Cloud Egress Cost Calculator for S3 Storage](https://marisstella.dev/tools/cloud-egress-calculator/): Compare monthly S3-compatible storage, request, and data egress costs for a real workload. Free, private, and runs in your browser.
- [IFTA Quarterly Fuel Tax Calculator](https://marisstella.dev/tools/ifta-quarterly-fuel-tax-calculator/): Work your IFTA quarterly return from your own trip and fuel records: average fleet MPG, taxable gallons and net taxable gallons per jurisdiction, the Indiana/Kentucky/Virginia surcharge charged the way it is actually charged, and interest on a late return. Free, private, nothing leaves your browser.

## More free tools

- [Free Electronics Calculators — AI Engineering Academy](https://marisstella.dev/tools/ai-engineering-academy/): A small set of free, private electronics calculators that run entirely in your browser: resistor color codes and Ohm's law, LED series resistors, voltage dividers with load correction, and 555 timer astable/monostable design. No signup, no ads, nothing uploaded.
- [Menu Engineering Calculator](https://marisstella.dev/tools/menu-engineering-calculator/): Free menu engineering calculator for independent restaurants: enter each dish's plate food cost, menu price and units sold to classify it as a star, plowhorse, puzzle or dog, see contribution margin against the menu average, and size what a price move on the high-volume low-margin plates is worth a year. Nothing leaves your browser.
